title: Multi-Collateral Dai launches and Single-Collateral Dai becomes SAI
description: MakerDAO launched Multi-Collateral Dai and renamed the original ETH-only Dai token to SAI. The active issuance system moved to the new DAI while SAI holders were directed toward migration or settlement paths.
notes: This event establishes SAI as a separate historical predecessor rather than an alias of current DAI.

title: HUSD suffers a severe depeg after Huobi delisting
description: HUSD lost most of its U.S. dollar value during October 2022 as Huobi removed support. Surviving public evidence does not establish a later full recovery or a durable current direct-redemption process.
notes: The event supports discontinued or inactive treatment but not a fully documented collapse or insolvency finding.

title: IRON loses its peg during a bank run and TITAN collapse
description: Large redemptions and a collapse in the TITAN share token broke IRON's partially collateralized redemption design. The stablecoin did not recover as a functioning one-dollar asset.
notes: The original Polygon and BNB Chain representations are treated as deployments of one failed historical entity.

title: mStable relaunch focuses on new yield products while mUSD remains legacy
description: mStable's current relaunch materials focus on a Pendle-based yield product, while the public site retains a separate legacy withdrawal route. mUSD is therefore recorded as limited rather than as a current flagship issuance product.
notes: This event does not prove that every mUSD contract is disabled; current mint availability remains an open question.

title: mStable mainnet availability is reported
description: A contemporaneous community link record announced that mStable was live on mainnet on May 29, 2020, and a later independent historical account identified the same date. The original first-party outbound announcement was not recovered, so this event is medium-confidence and does not set the canonical launch date.
notes: Best-known public-launch candidate only. The canonical launch_date remains null.

title: mStable production security program covers core mUSD functions
description: mStable documentation states that its production bug-bounty program had been running since June 5, 2020 and covered the mAsset contracts together with MINT, SWAP, REDEEM, and SAVE functionality.
notes: This confirms production functionality by June 5 and remains separate from the unresolved original public-launch day.
